chapter: Early years and the Sonny South
title: Playing music for a living while still at school, until the day job in 1939
summary: Turner explains he was still in school when he started playing professionally, then played music full time until 1939.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: When you say that you started playing professionally, you mean that you didn't have any other job? You had no day job?
No, I started playing professional musicians.
Oh, but you still had another job?

No, well I was out in school. Oh, you were still in school? Yeah, I was still in school then, you see. Well, I was going at my town in thirty-five when I was beginning of it, you understand? I was going to have a sort of playing, I was in school.
And when you left school, did you go into some other kind of work or did you just-
No, I played music then. Just music, that's all. Just music then, you see.
How long did you keep doing that before you started having that job?
Well, I started playing job in 1939.
So up till then you just played music? Yeah, before that.
